body:
Founder: 'fix the forward-declaration typing gap.' Added resolve_param_prototype_type()/build_defn_prototype() to src/emit.c, mirroring emit_defn's own parameter-shape matching. Forward decls are now fully typed (RetType name(T1,T2,...);) instead of empty-parens/K&R-style, falling back to empty parens only for shapes the mirror doesn't recognize. Verified with a standalone repro that this turns the exact by-value/pointer bug class that caused the Star segfault (fixed in 9a622f5) into a hard gcc compile ERROR, no -Wall needed. All 336 compiler tests pass (2 updated for the new typed prototype format). Rebuilt turbogrep, re-verified byte-identical against real grep across the 951-file corpus, Star repro still correct. Commit 99ef91a.

⚓ ☃
title: Forward-declaration typing gap fixed (G4) — gcc now catches by-value/pointer mismatches at compile time
